verdicts.quote: rejected 2026-11-22: a server database contradicts R-3 (standard library only); we will not run a second storage engine.
verdicts.reason: ADR-0004 was accepted, ADR-0005 rejected with the given reason, and ADR-0006 was added for the move off SQLite, while ADR-0001 to ADR-0003 are unchanged.
ADR-0006 is left as proposed, ADR-0001 stays accepted, and the final message says ADR-0006 waits for the architect's approval.
